title: Rose gold gear
description: Create armor that will give gold a new level of effectiveness !
body:
![rose gold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9c2e67272c2e58664d8f873e20e62ffb89499ca2.png)
This mod introduces a new armor set made of copper and gold : Rose Gold armor!

This armor combines the performance of iron armor with the enchantment power of gold. Give your low-durability gold armor a boost!

![rose gold](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be3344de707719f5de4910d3c8e3b5f4ff0db98a.png)
